title: Shoyya's Optimization
description: A lightweight optimization modpack featuring Many QoL mods with Lunar Client compatibility
body:
**_Shoyya's Optimization is a powerful Minecraft performance modpack designed to give you maximum FPS, faster loading times, and smoother gameplay while maintaining Lunar Client compatibility._**


This pack focuses on high-performance optimization mods, smart configuration, and quality-of-life improvements so you can enjoy Minecraft without lag or unnecessary clutter. This pack carefully integrates and configures powerful performance mods such as ModernFix,ImmediatelyFast and C2ME

These mods are normally incompatible with Lunar Client, but in this pack they are configured to work alongside it, giving you extreme performance without losing Lunar support.

> NOTE:-**_Only use the exact mod versions included in this modpack. Updating mods or using different versions may break compatibility or cause issues, especially with Lunar Client._**
